Name: Curly Dramatic Penny-- original concept art hair-- content patcher
Author: ZoeW
Description:
Content patcher mod. Penny is hot and I am fixing the errors of her creator. This mod brings back the curly hair from the early development concept art, plus I made her a little more buff (working with children is not for the week) and made her reactions much more dramatic, which makes her a bit more fun to talk/give gifts to.
Mod does not include beach outfits or forward facing Penny.
Please enjoy.
